page.layout: One column of running text. Printed page 486 at the top left, running head "DE VITA" at the top right. Marginal notes in the left margin, in italic type, beside the first lines of the text.

main_text.p: Obtrectatoribus autem non caruit Ari-stoteles maximè verò in iis quæ de piscibus disputauit, in quibus eum plus iusto curiosiorem fuisse & scrupulosiorem prodiderunt, vix enim sciri posse affirmarunt, quæde generatione & coitu aquatilium tradidit.

Constanter hoc asserendum, omnia fere, quæ de piscibus cognita sunt, Aristoteli debere accepta referri,& q aliorum libros, quos de piscib. exararunt, (ut sunt Oppian°, Ælianus, Seleucus Tarsensis) evoluerit, comperiet ab Aristotele tanquam limpidissimo & abundantissimo fonte rivulos eorum defluxisse. A-pud Latinos pauci admodum ex antiquis rem piscariam attigerunt. Solus Plinius in hac materia videtur Latinos adiuvisse, in arctum enim fatetur ipse collegisse, quæ Aristoteles de animalibus prodidit, quo nobis labore latine loquitur Aristoteles. Mirari subit à Romanis tam ofcitanter rem piscariam fuisse prætermissam, cum constet statim ab urbe condita piscis marinos in usu fuisse, postea verò orbe deuicto luxuriáque urbem invadente, cœperunt Proceres Romani piscinas instituere, in quibus pretiosissimos piscis alerent educarentque, ex quibus etiam magnos reditus capiebant. Claudebant autem dulcibus aquis piscis marinos, eosque gula maximè probabat, quia in suburbanis litoribus inveniretur, quod ab ipsis Gadibus aut mari

page.notes: Left margin note, italic, in four lines with hyphens: "Solus A-ristoteles accuratissime scripsit de animalibus"? The last words read "psit: bali-" and "entica.", which I could not read with certainty; the note is transcribed as "Solus A-ristoteles accuratis-sime scri-psit: bali-entica." The word "accuratissime" is joined here, and "balı-entica" is doubtful. Main text: "ofcitanter" and "quæde" are printed as they stand (probable printing errors). "Mirari subit" and the end "mari" are likely cut at the page edge; the last word may continue on the next page. The page number "48G" is read as 486, with the last digit doubtful. The text "Claudebant" appears mid-line, not as a new paragraph.
